test: media-player-playback › the next song while one plays › crossfades to the pad of another set, in the same key
summary: _isCurrentSongActive ignored the pad set, so Play on a song with its own pad set did nothing after a song in the same key and tempo

test: media-player-playback › the next song while one plays › fades the pads out / stops the click when switched off meanwhile
summary: my test set _padsOn/_clickOn directly; the switches fade out and stop at once, so _startSong's 'toggled off while playing' branches are unreachable in use

test: song-settings › resetting a song puts back its key, capo and tempo, and keeps them put
summary: Reset song left the old BPM on screen (and the media player's click) when the key also changed; the data was reset

test: setlist-page › the capo preference › shows each song's capo when the preference is turned on
summary: Turning the capo preference on or off while a setlist was open gave every song the first song's capo, because the page read the song-index attribute, which the song display does not set.

test: setlist-page › reordering songs › keeps each song display knowing its place
summary: After moving a song in the overview, the song displays and their sections kept their old song-index, so section states were applied to the wrong songs until the page was reloaded.

test: pad-set-service › uploading a set from a zip file › puts a file for each key in a folder in Drive
summary: A pad set zip named like Warm_Pad-Set.zip was named WarmPad Set: underscores were stripped before they could become spaces.

test: library-view › the key › keeps the sections as the user has set them
summary: Changing the key of a library song in edit mode drew its sections again from what was saved, losing the hidden, collapsed and chords-only choices made since.

test: storage-page › logging out › says so, and stays connected, when the service worker cannot do it
summary: logout() ignored a failed reply from the service worker, so the page said 'Successfully logged out' while the sign-in was still stored.

test: import-setlist.playwright.ts › an email with no date asks for one, and a date that has a setlist is pointed out (and a link from the email Worker opens the review)
summary: A hash-only navigation (a link to #here, or a second link that differs by its fragment) leaves a history entry with no state, and the router threw reading history.state.key on the popstate.

test: google-auth-flows › authorizing › fails when the worker cannot keep the blob
summary: authorizeWithGoogle ignored a failed reply from the service worker to STORE_BLOB, so the sign-in looked successful with nothing kept.
